mcp.anleitung: Gregor Wetter returns raw hourly weather values for any place. Reply in the person's language. All times are local time of the place (with UTC offset). The data are raw values without assessment; interpret them yourself.
mcp.werkzeug.ort_suchen: Searches places for a free text and returns up to 5 candidates with name, country, lat, lon and time zone.
mcp.werkzeug.wetter: Raw hourly weather values (temperature, precipitation, precipitation probability, wind, gusts, cloud cover, thunderstorms, sunshine minutes, snowfall limit, freezing level) for a place in local time, at most 7 days. Place as a name (ort) or as coordinates (lat and lon). If several places match the name, you get a list of candidates instead of weather: if one is clearly meant (for example the largest or best-known city, or the place from the conversation), call wetter again right away with its lat and lon; ask the person only if it is genuinely unclear.
mcp.feld.text: Place name, ideally with country or region, for example "Frankfurt am Main".
mcp.feld.ort: Place name. Together with lat and lon only used as display name.
mcp.feld.von: Start as ISO 8601 in local time, for example 2026-11-22T14:00. Default: now.
mcp.feld.bis: End as ISO 8601 in local time. Default: 24 hours after the start; at most 7 days.
mcp.fehler.konto: This account cannot use the connector.
mcp.fehler.ort_unbekannt: The place "{ort}" was not found. Please write the name more precisely, for example with country or region, or give lat and lon.
mcp.fehler.eingabe: Please give a place name with at most {max} characters.
mcp.fehler.ortssuche: The place search is not reachable right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
mcp.fehler.wetterdienst: The weather service is not reachable right now. Please try again later.
mcp.fehler.bremse: Too many requests in a short time. Please try again in {sekunden} seconds.
mcp.fehler.kontingent: The daily quota for weather requests is used up. Possible again in about {minuten} minutes.
mcp.fehler.ort_fehlt: Please give either ort or lat and lon.
mcp.fehler.koordinaten_ungueltig: lat must be between -90 and 90 and lon between -180 and 180.
mcp.fehler.zeitpunkt_ungueltig: The time given for von or bis is not valid. Expected ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-22T14:00.
mcp.fehler.bis_vor_von: The end of the period (bis) must be after its start (von).
mcp.fehler.zeitraum_ausserhalb: There are no hourly values for this period: it lies in the past or beyond the forecast (at most about 7 days ahead).
mcp.fehler.eingabe_ungueltig: The request is not valid. Please check ort or lat and lon as well as von and bis.
mcp.hinweis.mehrdeutig: Several places match "{ort}". Call wetter again with lat and lon of the intended candidate; ask the person only if the conversation does not make clear which one is meant.
mcp.hinweis.begrenzt: The period was limited to 7 days; the values end at {ende}.
mcp.oauth.frage_ohne_name: Connect a program to Gregor Wetter?
mcp.oauth.darf: It will then be able to:
mcp.oauth.darf_wetter: search places and request weather, counted against your request quota
mcp.oauth.darf_nicht: It does not see your trips, locations, recipients or other account data.
mcp.oauth.weiter_zu: Only connect if you started this yourself in the Claude app just now. Afterwards you'll continue to {host}.
mcp.oauth.warnung_localhost: Warning: the code goes to a program on this device (localhost). Only allow this if you have just started it yourself, for example Claude Code.
mcp.oauth.neu_verbinden: Please reconnect the connector in the Claude app.
mcp.oauth.nicht_freigegeben: Your account is not enabled for the connector "Gregor Wetter".
mcp.oauth.ruecksprung: This redirect address is not allowed.
